_doc: Ordinary PRs run affected business Lua specs and enforce full-PR unit diff only; partial whole coverage/baselines are null and never update history/badges. Fixed CI self-tests remain full. Release first requires normal full UT, then full unit/emulator coverage with original overall unit/combined ratchets and dated/module floors. No thresholds, dates or tolerance are reduced; no release unit-diff floor is added. Combined release diff uses the nearest true combined ancestor excluding the candidate; full unit/combined overall lookup includes the candidate. Coverage is manual full backfill only; its writer verifies the target's ancestor unit ratchet including same-SHA, never newer descendants. Release persists genuine full measurements synchronously. Scope: main.lua, weread/**/*.lua, integrations/**/*.lua; unexecuted files count as 0.
